biography.bio:
A pilot and lookout whose mask lets him go small enough to get anywhere.

Masks: Gulliver (wearing Gulliver).

Vehicles: @UUID[Compendium.essence20-homebrew-starter.mask_vehicles.Actor.RfrD13Wqwt5jh9V2]{Raven}.

M.A.S.K. - M.A.S.K. homebrew; stats built with the Threat Builder (Field Guide rules).

system.description:
Shrinks or enlarges whatever it is pointed at - for a little while.

Calhoun Burns's mask. Bonded to the first agent who puts it on: for them, it gives +1 Toughness and its power works a number of times per scene equal to their Speed. One mask at a time.

automation.notes: Rolls Targeting against the target's Toughness; a hit shrinks it (Acting Smaller) until the end of its next turn. Enlarging objects is up to the GM. Speed uses per scene and +1 Toughness, only for the bonded wearer (Power Gear: bonded, mask slot).

system.description:
You know your ride like your own hands. A vehicle you are driving has +1 Evasion and Edge on its Driving Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive gets +1 Evasion, and its Driving Tests have Edge.

system.description:
You drive with one hand and aim with the other. A vehicle you are driving has Edge on its Targeting Tests.

M.A.S.K. homebrew.

automation.notes: Automatic: the vehicle you drive has Edge on its Targeting Tests (its weapons).
